question: Which version of this flow is active, which is latest, and who changed each?

steps.name: definition
steps.soql: SELECT DeveloperName, ActiveVersion.VersionNumber, LatestVersion.VersionNumber FROM FlowDefinition WHERE DeveloperName = '{name}'

steps.name: versions
steps.soql: SELECT VersionNumber, Status, ProcessType, ApiVersion, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM Flow WHERE Definition.DeveloperName = '{name}' ORDER BY VersionNumber DESC

verdicts.say: {name} has no active version: it does not run.
{name}: version {= definition.records[0]["ActiveVersion.VersionNumber"]} is active, but version {= definition.records[0]["LatestVersion.VersionNumber"]} is newer and not active.

traps: A deploy can leave the new version as Draft or inactive. Check here after every deploy.
Retiring a flow means no active version; the definition stays.
